sloka: अहो त्वम् कर्णिकार अद्य पुष्पितः शोभसे भृशम् ।कर्णिकार प्रियाम् साध्वीम् शंस दृष्टा यदि प्रिया ॥३-६०-२०॥
transliteration: aho tvam karṇikāra adya puṣpitaḥ śobhase bhṛśam ।karṇikāra priyām sādhvīm śaṁsa dṛṣṭā yadi priyā ॥3-60-20॥

translations.english: O Karnikara tree with flowers in full bloom, tell me if you have seen my faithful beloved who is fond of karnikara flowers.
